text:
Mia Chen: Quick pulse — build green on main, canary passed on 3/3 hosts. i18n strings failing in staging (missing key for zh). Thinking: do we hold cutoff for patch or push and hotfix next week? @Sanjay @Tom
Tom Nguyen: Saw the failing test; root cause is new tokenizer split change. I can revert tokenizer patch in a hotfix branch, but that requires a version bump. ETA ~2hrs if we go hotfix.
Sanjay Patel: If we delay, we slip announcement to tomorrow. Are there any customer-facing features in this ship that *must* go today? @Elaine
Elaine Ortiz: Nothing blocking marketing — we prefer stable. If we slip, I'll update #announcements with a short note. Either way, give me final copy by EOD.
Mia Chen: No mandatory features. Priority is not to break CN regional customers. Recommendation: cut release now without the tokenizer change (revert commit c7a9), publish patch branch, and schedule tokenizer in next minor. Who can prep revert? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Tom Nguyen: I'll PR the revert (`git revert c7a9 --no-edit`) and run CI. Will also prepare `v1.8.2-hotfix` branch and bump to `1.8.2`.
Jia Li: I'll do changelog entry and add regression note. Can someone tag the release notes with the rollback steps?
release-bot: Deploy-checklist: 1) tests green 2) canary ok 3) changelog updated 4) release notes drafted. Link: https://ci.internal/runs/9845
Mia Chen: OK Tom, ping me when PR is up. If CI flakes, we hold and Elaine posts a slip notice: `We’re postponing today’s release to tomorrow AM due to a localization regression.`
Tom Nguyen: PR opened: https://git.internal/pull/5247 — CI queued. Revert applied, version bumped in `setup.py` to `1.8.2`.
Sanjay Patel: Running quick e2e against staging now. If green in 30m we can proceed with deploy window at 18:00 PT.
Mia Chen: If deploy proceeds, Elaine please use this copy for #announcements: `Heads up — release 1.8.2 will go out at 18:00 PT. We fixed a localization regression; no breaking changes. If anything goes wrong we'll rollback to 1.8.1 and notify.`
Elaine Ortiz: Got it. I'll queue the announcement and schedule a follow-up at +2h. :white_check_mark:
Mia Chen: Locking decision: proceed with revert + hotfix. Fallback plan: rollback playbook v1.8 -> v1.7 available at https://confluence/rollback-playbook. @DevOps Agent please standby for rollback ops.
DevOps Agent: Acknowledged. I’ll monitor metrics and hold the rollback runbook. Alerts set for error-rate >2%.
Mia Chen: Thanks all — will update thread when CI passes. :v:
Tom Nguyen: CI green. Starting canary at 18:00 PT. I'll post results.
Tom Nguyen: Canary metrics: latency +1ms, error-rate 0.0%. Green across canaries. Proceeding to full rollout.
release-bot: Post-deploy smoke: ok. Release `1.8.2` published. Changelog: https://releases.internal/1.8.2
Elaine Ortiz: Announcement posted to #announcements. Copy: `Release 1.8.2 live — addressed localization regression. Thanks team!` :tada:
Mia Chen: Closing thread — mark as shipped. If any regressions, reopen. Great job.
